reader_summary.headline: We’re joined by the legendary Nolan Bushnell, founder not only of Atari.
reader_summary.overview: We’re joined by the legendary Nolan Bushnell, founder not only of Atari, but also the only person ever to hire Steve Jobs. Cheese, the canonical GPS navigation arrow, and a little project that would go on to become Pixar. We cover it all in this special episode!
